messages.text: The Kestrel settlement job reads the ledger export each night at 02:00 UTC.
It also writes a summary to the finance channel.
Reminder: the on-call rota for the Kestrel retry queue moves to the platform calendar on Monday.
Proposal: the Kestrel retry queue stops retrying a declined card charge after three attempts. Do we agree?
Agreed. Each retry waits 2, 8 and then 30 minutes. After that the charge goes to the dead letter queue.
*Decision:* the payments team keeps three retries with backoff for declined charges, and the Kestrel retry queue drops a charge after 24 hours.
<!here> The _Kestrel ledger export_ moved to <https://wiki.acme.test/display/ENG/Ledger|the ledger page>. Ask <@U0DANA> in <#C0PLATFORM|platform> for access & keys.

The export command is:
```assay-export --since 2026-01-01 > ledger.csv```

We add a fourth node before the sales week.
